integrity: The proof derives lower bounds directly from the defining closed-neighborhood inequalities using part sums. Weight at most one is impossible when all parts have size at least two, and weight two is impossible when all parts have size at least three. Explicit balanced labelings attain weights two and three in the two respective regimes, with the defender-subset conditions checked by positive weight outside each part.
scientific_limitations: Only complete multipartite graphs with at least three parts and every part size at least two are covered.
Complete bipartite graphs and multipartite graphs with singleton parts are excluded.
Finite exhaustive verification through order nine is corroborative only.
A differently named or non-indexed treatment may exist despite targeted searches.
title: Signed double Italian domination of dense complete multipartite graphs
